feedback.source_locator: Section V.A–B, PDF p.9; Figure 8, p.11; scheme definitions Table I, p.7
feedback.caption: DALINE graded attempt-averaged scores: GPT4o-Sole 0.00, GPT4o-SR 31.37, CGPT4o-R 33.82 and GPT4o-Full 93.13. The evaluation uses 34 tasks with a maximum of three attempts each, awarding 100/50/0 points and carrying the last executed score into unused slots. This is not a final-completion fraction.
feedback.assumptions: Reported values preserved. API schemes use gpt-4o-2024-05-13; CGPT4o-R is the ChatGPT4o built-in-RAG product scheme. Complete-system comparison, not isolated causal effects. No binomial interval or implied completed-task count.

veragrid.caption: Three explicitly selected same-model comparisons from VeraGrid-MCQ-150: GPT-5.2 64/150 without tools versus 149/150 with the solver-agent; Claude Sonnet 4.5 71/150 versus 149/150; Gemini 3 Flash 74/150 versus 150/150. veragrid.assumptions: First three Table I rows selected for legibility, not ranked. Template-derived MCQs share one solved feeder. Repeated-run uncertainty is unspecified; results do not estimate field-control reliability or arbitrary-feeder generalization.
